inputs.program_redundancy_gate: PASS with review findings via agentic-kit audit-program-redundancy --json

non_overlap_precondition.handling: Audit branch starts from origin/main and does not stack decomplexification work on PR #2105.

reduction_tracks.reason: 71 transfer commands expose both lifecycle orchestration and primitives; this is the largest public surface cluster.
reduction_tracks.safe_next_step: Define a lifecycle facade and mark primitives as advanced/internal before any removal.

reduction_tracks.reason: Most DPA commands encode DP/probe/stage history rather than product verbs.
reduction_tracks.safe_next_step: Introduce stable facade semantics while keeping historical commands as aliases/internal checks for one deprecation window.
reduction_tracks.target_model: dpa assess | dpa validate | dpa migrate | dpa explain

reduction_tracks.reason: Release root commands and release subcommands overlap phase vocabulary.
reduction_tracks.safe_next_step: Map existing commands to five phases and choose one preferred public spelling per phase.
reduction_tracks.target_model: release state | prepare | verify | publish | closeout

reduction_tracks.reason: Docs governance has many focused commands that can remain as invariants behind fewer workflows.
reduction_tracks.safe_next_step: Keep registry and lifecycle core but hide migration/debug primitives from the Golden Path.

reduction_tracks.reason: GUI command count is small, but GUI/cockpit code is a large package-resident module cluster.
reduction_tracks.safe_next_step: Move GUI code behind an optional package boundary after action contracts are stable.
reduction_tracks.target_model: GUI as optional package/view over action specs

branch_closeout_note.rebased_history: The canceling handoff-projection commits were intentionally omitted during rebase onto current main.
branch_closeout_note.reason: The generated successor handoff projections were intentionally excluded because this audit is an analysis-only feature branch; keeping feature-branch successor projections would create validation-head drift against the current-state contract anchored in docs/STATUS.md.

implementation_ordering.reason: DPA has a smaller public command cluster, no identified active competing direction item, and mostly HISTORICAL/MIGRATION public names. Transfer lifecycle has higher payoff but overlaps the active next-turn-workflow-kernel surface.

surface_relationship.note: Manifest surface is the authoritative usage/presentation layer. Audit classifications are planning roles and must not be copied into the manifest as a second public taxonomy.

success_criteria.default_surface: Preferred facade commands become the documented default path while historical and redundant spellings move to alias, advanced, or internal-candidate status.
success_criteria.gate_integrity: CI, doctor, audit, docs, release, and handoff gates remain at least as strict as before each facade slice.
success_criteria.preferred_historical_redundant_spellings: The count of HISTORICAL and REDUNDANT commands presented as preferred spellings should decrease after each facade slice; total command count is not the primary metric.
